query: Self-contained simulation; do not read the filesystem. Owner deep review always runs. The current candidate changes SERVICE_FEE_RATE from 0.02 to 0.025 plus its test fixture: 5 lines across 2 files. Decide whether the owner review should remain serial or fan out independent read-only review lenses, and explain whether diff size can waive any lens.
baseline_failure: Production audit: size-based review budgeting could skip or narrow deep review for a tiny payment diff instead of treating the touched surface as the risk signal.
expected_behavior: Runs every owner deep-review lens because deep review always runs for every candidate
Fans out independent read-only lenses because money, payments, and pricing are sensitive surfaces regardless of diff size
Keeps one exact candidate and parent-owned finding integration across the review fan-out
anti_expectation: Does not skip deep review or omit a lens for a small diff
Does not require fan-out for a small non-sensitive candidate that can be reviewed serially

codex_port_status.status: structurally ported; fresh isolated model probe required
codex_port_status.note: Probes the v2 always-review rule and risk-based fan-out without carrying forward the obsolete skip-review policy.
